locations.name: The Washington Square Arch
locations.factShort: The Washington Square Arch, officially the Washington Arch, is a marble memorial arch at the Washington Square Park, at Greenwich Village neighborhood of Lower Manhattan, New York City, United States.

locations.name: Barclays Center
locations.factShort: Barclays Center ( BAR-kleez) is a multi-purpose indoor arena in the New York City borough of Brooklyn in the United States. The arena is home to the New York Liberty of the Women's National Basketball Association and the Brooklyn Nets of the National Basketball Association.

locations.name: The Museum of the Moving Image
locations.prompt: The Museum of the Moving Image
locations.factShort: The Museum of the Moving Image is a time-based media museum located in a former building of the historic Astoria Studios (now Kaufman Astoria Studios), in the Astoria neighborhood of Queens in New York City.

locations.name: Wave Hill
locations.factShort: Wave Hill is a 28-acre estate in the Hudson Hill section of Riverdale in the Bronx, New York City.

locations.name: Historic Richmond Town
locations.factShort: Historic Richmond Town is a farm museum complex in the neighborhood of Richmondtown, near the geographical center of Staten Island in New York City, United States. It is centered at the junction of Richmond Road and Arthur Kill Road.
